strict_scope.proved: The fixed-size, fixed-window, fixed-jet-order, fixed-degree rational-polynomial determinant class is reduced exactly and its ordinary singleton-height shortcut is closed.
strict_scope.finite_only: The portable certificate replays bounded exact identities; it contains no exceptional-prime census or asymptotic extrapolation.
